t: Music editor and create compositions on screen
A complete live editor for creating full music compositions on screen and managing and editing them while playing audio performances with high audio quality.

Quick question: Yes, you can create a full music composition on screen without needing external programs. This free app is written in a simple language and runs directly in the browser, and lets you enter notes and scales and music annotations in an easy way. You can edit any note or add or delete at the click of a button. Then you can watch the musical performance with a synchronized timeline. The style is designed for beginners and musicians. The system supports musical keys and control over speed and audio quality with the ability to save results. It also supports multiple melodies at the same time. It also provides a fast and easy interface.
Can I play the performance after adding notes?
Yes, press the button and the system will follow the correct sequence.
What happens when I enter an incorrect note?
A warning will appear and you can correct it before playback.
Does it support more than one melody?
Yes, you can enter multiple melodies.
